name: eos-evidence-engine
description: Processes and computes evidence into automated governance decisions. Invoke when implementing evidence-based verification or confidence scoring.
author: EOS Development Team
trigger: Creating audit trails for all changes

inputs: work_id: string - Target work item identifier
evidence_paths: array - Paths to all evidence files
requirements: array - List of requirements to verify
outputs: confidence_score: float - Overall confidence in requirement completion
audit_trail.json with all decision timestamps and sources

preconditions: All evidence files are accessible and unmodified
Requirements are clearly defined with acceptance criteria

risks: Incorrect governance decisions from incomplete evidence
Audit trail gaps leading to compliance issues
False confidence scores masking unmet requirements
risk_assessment.impact: High - affects governance and compliance validity
risk_assessment.mitigation: Mandatory evidence validation before any governance decision

authority_boundaries: Can read all evidence files but cannot modify them
Can only write verdict and audit files to .eos-state/evidence/
Cannot modify locked directories: packages/eos-core/foundations/, src/eos/semantics/
